meta.title: 2 Days at Ba Na Hills – The Golden Bridge Experience & Overnight stay
meta.description:
Ba Na Hills is one of the most unique destinations in Vietnam. Famous for the Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands, this mountain resort also features a French village, temples, theme park rides, gardens and incredible cable car views.

In this video we spend 2 days exploring Ba Na Hills near Da Nang to see if it’s really worth visiting. From the famous Golden Bridge at sunrise to exploring the French village at night with almost no tourists, we experience everything this incredible place has to offer.

We also break down the important travel details including ticket prices, how to get there, and why staying overnight might be the best way to experience Ba Na Hills.

If you're planning a trip to Vietnam or visiting Da Nang, this guide will help you decide whether Ba Na Hills should be on your itinerary.

📍 Locations featured in this video:
Ba Na Hills
Golden Bridge
French Village
Luna Castle
Ba Na Hills cable car

comments.author: @RohanJitSingh
comments.text: So the hotel is at the top of the hill and at the bottom before the cable car ride? Little confused here. Do you have to take your luggage up via the cable car ride ?

comments.author: @LetsTravel-MF
comments.text: Yes, it’s the same hotel. When you arrive, you first check in at the bottom station/reception, where you’ll also pay for both your room and the Bana Hills entry ticket. Then you take the cable car up with your luggage. Once at the top, go to the hotel’s reception. They’ll check you in again and guide you to your room. It’s a bit of a process, but that’s how it works. 😅
